dialogues.speaker: Arsenyev
dialogues.text: Oh dear. If this goes on, Snezhnaya will surely be plunged into utter darkness... What do we do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's this about darkness? What's going on?

dialogues.speaker: Arsenyev
dialogues.text: Ah, you see, according to my sources, the real truth is that the Geo Archon from Liyue never actually died. And he isn't just alive, he went and split his spirit into a billion microscopic little pieces...

dialogues.speaker: Arsenyev
dialogues.text: ...and fused them right into every single piece of Mora. Just so he can eavesdrop and spy on exactly what's going on right here in Snezhnaya...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm not sure if there's anything anyone can do about that...

dialogues.speaker: Arsenyev
dialogues.text: The situation may be dire, but we must keep on thinking no matter what...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is that all that's worrying you?

dialogues.speaker: Arsenyev
dialogues.text: No, there's more. Word is, the Pyro Archon of Natlan is tossing kindling non-stop into a volcano... just so he can melt Zapolyarny Palace right down to nothing using sheer subterranean heat!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Um, wouldn't the Mora have heard what you just said then...?

dialogues.speaker: Arsenyev
dialogues.text: Oh my goodness! I'm done for this time! The Millelith who have infiltrated Snezhnaya will surely come to take me away tonight! What... what do I do now???

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Where are you hearing all of this from?

dialogues.speaker: Arsenyev
dialogues.text: That's top secret. Of course I have my magazines... and my sources...

dialogues.speaker: Arsenyev
dialogues.text: Right??? You think so too, don't you?
